title: A Simple Google Analytics Alternative for Small Sites and Side Projects
description: When GA4 is more than you need: what a simple analytics tool should cover, what you give up, and how to set up Pulzivo with one script tag.

title: Privacy-Friendly Analytics for Small Sites: A Practical Checklist
description: How to measure a small website without cookies or personal data by default: what to collect, what to skip, and questions to ask any analytics vendor.

title: Pulzivo vs GA4 vs Plausible vs Fathom: Pricing Compared (Oct 2026)
description: Side-by-side pricing for Pulzivo, Google Analytics 4, Plausible and Fathom as of October 2026, plus what each plan actually counts.

title: Plausible vs Pulzivo vs GA4 for Small Sites
description: A fair way to choose between Plausible, Pulzivo, and GA4: cookies, the free plan, events versus pageviews, and when GA4 is still the right tool.

title: Pulzivo Launch Offer: 50% Off for 12 Months
description: Until Pulzivo reaches 100 users, paid plans are 50% off for the first 12 months: $4.50, $14.50, or $49.50 a month. The free plan stays at 10,000 events.

title: How to Track UTM Campaigns Cleanly
description: Name utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign so reports stay readable, and build the URL with Pulzivo’s free UTM builder. Attribution is on Starter.

title: Core Web Vitals for Site Owners
description: What LCP, INP, and CLS measure, the good and poor cutoffs, and how to read field data. Web Vitals are included on Pulzivo’s free plan.

title: What Cookieless Analytics Actually Means
description: Cookieless means the analytics script does not set a cookie. It does not mean nothing is stored, and it is not a promise about consent banners.

title: Rage Clicks and Dead Clicks, Explained
description: Repeated clicks and clicks that do nothing point at broken or confusing UI. Pulzivo records rage clicks and dead clicks on the Enterprise plan.

title: How to Measure Form Abandonment
description: See which forms people start and leave, which fields they focused, and what to fix first. Form abandonment in Pulzivo is an Enterprise feature.

title: Read Bounce Rate Without GA4
description: A bounced session in Pulzivo is a session with one page view. Here is how to read that number, and which engagement signals matter more.

title: How to Add Analytics to WordPress Without Google
description: Paste one Pulzivo script into WordPress with a header plugin or header.php, then confirm a page view. You do not create a Google Analytics property.

title: How to Add Analytics to Shopify Without GA4
description: Pulzivo has no Shopify app. Paste the script into theme.liquid, then confirm a product page view. Checkout is not included.

title: Add an Analytics Script on Wix, Squarespace, or Webflow
description: Header steps for Wix, Squarespace, and Webflow, then a live page view. No Pulzivo app, and the host plan has to allow custom code.

title: See Which Social or Google Visit Reached Your Site
description: Facebook, Instagram, and Google Business often hide the referrer. A campaign link shows which button reached your site. Sources are on Starter.

title: How to Track Phone and Email Clicks on Your Site
description: tel: and mailto: taps are not outbound clicks. Mark them on Free, or use auto click tracking on Starter. Goals match the event name.

title: Exclude Your Own Visits So the Stats Aren't Just You
description: Open your site with ?pulz_owner=1. Pulzivo stores pulz_is_owner in that browser and stops sending your visits. Other visitors are unchanged.

title: What a Page View, a Visitor, and a Session Mean
description: A page view is one address load. A visitor is one browser for a calendar day. A session ends after 30 quiet minutes. Free shows page views.
